summary.en: Mastercard Start Path, launched in 2014, is Mastercard's global startup engagement program for later-stage fintechs. It runs a six-month virtual program, takes no equity or fee, evaluates 1,500+ applications a year and selects ~40 startups; Mastercard maintains a dedicated fund to invest when a strategic fit emerges. 230+ startups have participated and raised $2.7B in post-program capital.
